routing_warnings.description: The cache-configuration failure explicitly concerns the RIB test experience rather than the original site.
The lost fonts and formatting are a layout-integrity regression rather than execution evidence about page-load speed.

The later desktop/mobile score report follows discussion of the new-site experience and should be evaluated under the separate RIB page-speed Requirement rather than copied to the original-site lifecycle.
The mobile and desktop LCP result is the continuation of the preceding new-site optimization report and is better evaluated under the RIB page-speed Requirement.
This message reports a hidden-account discrepancy on Oakbridge, not South Pointe.
The client defines Oakbridge's approved administrator account and authorizes removal of all other users.
This implementation claim reports removal of Oakbridge's fake administrators.
This Wordfence configuration proposal concerns the Oakbridge site rather than South Pointe.
The reported scan results concern the Oakbridge site and may provide execution evidence for its security monitoring Requirement.
The Wordfence setup claim in this status report concerns Oakbridge rather than South Pointe.
The discovery of injected fake plugins primarily evidences active malware artifacts rather than hardening of legitimate vulnerable plugins.
Deactivation of infected plugins and deletion of a replicator file primarily describe eradication of active malware.
The request for Search Console access concerns Oakbridge search-engine cleanup, not South Pointe.
The submission of about 50 pornography and casino links concerns the subsequent Oakbridge cleanup.
The request to change the administrator password concerns Oakbridge rather than South Pointe.
The report that legitimate pages and posts were moved to trash and appeared blank primarily evidences the separate page and layout restoration Requirement.
The successful restoration of the site to the June 28 backup and its normal appearance primarily concerns page and layout restoration; malware removal was still described as ongoing.
The reported blank pages and trashed legitimate pages concern restoration of legitimate site content rather than deletion of injected spam.
The backup restoration and return to a normal appearance concern page and layout restoration.
Submission of malicious links for removal concerns external search-index cleanup rather than deletion of spam content from Oakbridge.
WP Engine's clean malware scan verifies executable malware eradication but does not specifically verify deletion of injected spam posts.
The reported active Wordfence attack blocking concerns South Pointe, not Oakbridge.
WP Engine's clean internal malware scan verifies Oakbridge cleanup rather than the operation of Oakbridge Wordfence monitoring.
The removal of 19 hacking backdoors supports general malware and backdoor eradication but does not specifically identify plugin or theme hardening.
This password-rotation request concerns the South Pointe site rather than Oakbridge.
This reminder to update WP Engine and WordPress administrator passwords concerns South Pointe rather than Oakbridge.
The client's completed password change concerns South Pointe and cannot verify Oakbridge credential rotation.
